title: delivery profile (profile/delivery-profile.json)
description: Field names follow the vendored matcher's user object verbatim (golden fixtures are the semantics SSoT). Crosswalk from saita-kun-planner input/company-profile.json: employees -> employee_count, region -> company_prefecture / company_municipality. Attributes only — no company name, no secrets (those live in GHA Secrets / env). Committed to the adopter's private repo so scheduled runs can read it.

terms_accepted_sha256.description: sha256 of TERMS.md at consent time. Runner refuses to run when it no longer matches (re-consent via /setup).

company_prefecture.description: Japanese prefecture name (e.g. 東京都). Mapped to romaji internally.

categories.description: Must stay in sync with CATEGORY_KEYS in lib/match-user-subsidy.js (checked by tools/check-profile.sh). null/empty = no constraint.

purposes.description: Must stay in sync with PURPOSE_KEYS in lib/match-user-subsidy.js. null/empty = no constraint.

feed_base_url.description: Base location containing meta.json / subsidies.json.gz. Configurable by design (dr-004: producer substitutability).
